source_clause: R1HVS1.2.) For independent seat zones soft control, when the heated or vented seat is turned on for the first time in a key cycle, the seat zone button will default to back and cushion. A press of the seat zone button opens the pop up and moves to the next available state in the cycle (back and cushion, back, cushion etc.). The pop up will have a «Driver Seat Zone» label for the driver and «Passenger Seat Zone» label for the passenger. The pop up will not open if the user presses the greyed out button.
reasoning: 驗證目標：11.7（R1HVS1.2）以四句定出座椅分區軟控之 key cycle 預設、按壓開 popup 並前進一態、popup 之兩種標籤，以及灰化時不開 popup，四個 037 leaf 逐句對應。關鍵情境條件：同 11.6.1（條文自帶之無硬控限定語）；依 **R-C34** 三軸暴露 → 補。為什麼這樣切：`061-04`（灰化時不開）為 `061-02`（按壓即開）之否定側，二者成正反兩側（§7）。刻意略過：**`061-03` 之標籤取條文之逐字原文 «Driver Seat Zone»／«Passenger Seat Zone»**（profile §3.4 之 source-quoted token），**其餘 popup 內容不驗**（DR #11）；`061-01` 之 key cycle 為條文用語，不定義其起訖時點（§8.4.1）。

tcs.tc_title: The seat zone button defaults to back and cushion in a key cycle
tcs.test_item:
R1HVS1.2.) For independent seat zones soft control, when the heated or vented seat is turned on for the first time in a key cycle, the seat zone button will default to back and cushion.

(read the seat zone button -> The seat zone button shows back and cushion)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with the seat zone feature without a hard control or capacitive control, for which a soft button controls it (11.6.1)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
5. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not a front-climate-only vehicle, for which the comfort tabs are not displayed (2.1)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Start a new key cycle
2. Turn the heated seat on
3. Read the seat zone button
tcs.expected_result:
1. A new key cycle is started
2. The heated seat is on
3. The seat zone button shows back and cushion
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ch16 十八節中僅 `16.16`（ICE15）提及座椅圖示（「Off icon of seats will depend on system configuration」，其 leaf `122-02` 已停下），**無一節定義加熱／通風座椅、加熱方向盤或座椅分區之按壓循環、層級呈現或其 popup**；故本條之 EMEA 排除**無 ch16 對造句可依**，屬 R-C36-1 之過嚴側（同 DR #41 之形態）
